batting.dismissal: c RA Jadeja b MM Sharma

batting.dismissal: c MG Johnson b Sandeep Sharma

batting.dismissal: c M Kartik b MG Johnson

batting.name: MS Dhoni
batting.dismissal: c GJ Bailey b MG Johnson

balls.text: this is flatter but still carried over the rope. Bailey has made 40 off 13 balls! In the slot again and Bailey slapped it straight down the ground. James Anderson must be smiling somewhere
slower ball and Bailey has launched it over long-on. What a hit! Came forward and let that bat swing right back to his shoulder
slower ball, on a length. Bailey waited for it and slogged it to deep midwicket for a couple. We're already well into the highest score of the season
full and outside off, Bailey walks across to try and scoop the ball. Gets just enough bat on it to trickle down to the fine leg boundary. Very cheeky
goes for the wide yorker and Mitch juts his bat out and collects a single to third man

that's gone through. Faf ran in to try and take the catch, but then seeing the ball was dipping he tried to get the body in line with it. But in the end it strikes him and sneaks off to the long-on boundary. Short ball, slogged away
that's the fourth four of the over. Cleared his front leg and blasted this fuller ball over the covers
slower ball outside off, Bailey slams it down the ground but a couple of fingers from the bowler on his follow through saves it

mid-off was inside the circle and Bailey has lofted this length ball to the boundary. All he wanted was to lob it over the fielder as he made room and though the bowler followed him, he made good enough connection
terrific placement again. The bowler switched around the wicket and sought a wide yorker, Bailey got down with it and let it run off the face to the point boundary
did I say he was out of form? He must have heard me and taken offense. This was in the slot, half-volley outside off and Bailey has hammered it past extra cover
starts with a yorker that targets leg stump, Mitch is beside it and pushes to long-off
shortish and it's been placed brilliantly. Walked across to off stump and pulled it well fine of the man at deep square leg
short of a length on middle, Mitch tries to pull it away but inside edges it. The ball stops beside his legs and Bailey races off for a single
good length ball, punched into the covers
a taste of his own medicine to start and Mitch was a little surprised. Manages to dab it fine enough to beat deep third man though

again! He's holed out at deep midwicket. This was a little slower and fuller outside off, Maxi wound up and slogged. Dragging it might have hurt him for power and Jaddu took it safely inside the rope and then teased fate by walking back to the boundary and acting as if he was about to step over it. What's the point of a wicket if you can't have a bit of fun with it
shortish and outside off, Bailey dabs it to third man to get Maxi back on strike
seeks the yorker and gets it to tail in a touch, Bailey swings and gets a thick outside edge to third man
full toss on middle, Maxi clears his front leg and slams it down the ground. Went off the bottom of the bat and he gets a single. He's in those nervous nineties now
saw him backing away and he sends in a slower yorker outside off, Maxi reaches out and bunts it back to the bowler.
how unlucky is that. It was lovely yorker, tailing in on middle and leg. Maxi looked to belt it through midwicket again, but gets an inside edge that wanders away to the fine leg boundary
full and angled into him, Bailey goes for the flick but doesn't connect. Settles for a leg-bye and puts Maxwell on strike
went for a reverse slog again, but this time the ball was a little too full and spearing in on leg. Gets struck on the pads. Pandey goes up in appeal, but that was sliding down

Smith does it again! Last time he got Maxi, this time he gets Miller! It was full and he was looking to lash it through the covers. Gets an inside edge that uproots off stump. Threw his head back in disappointment, he was three away from a fifty but besides that Punjab were batting Chennai into submission
slides too far down the leg side with a short ball. Misses the pull
full and outside off, whipped down to long-on. Is he going to get that three-figure mark finally?
Dhawan catches it at the dug out this time. Maxi is just having some fun with those reverse slogs! Got under it and powered it comfortably over the rope
goes for the up and over point, but he went a little too far under the short ball outside off
another one! This was in the slot and Maxi made sure he was on the leg side of it and pummeled it straight down the ground. Slower ball picked and massacred
he's caught! But by the ball boy beyond the boundary! There is no stopping that reverse slog from Maxi. And this was the perfect length too, sat up for the hot
that's a monster! Had the width and he got under it to carve it into the crowd behind cover. That ball followed a hyberbolic trajectory. Flat and kept gaining height
hurled in at the pads and strikes the batsman there
more use of the feet as he swipes a flatter delivery away to the left of long-on
looks to slash it through the covers, but he mis-hits it. Gets a thick edge that beats short third man
tossed up and he looks to play against the spin towards his favourite midwicket region. Jaddu slowed it up and fooled Maxi in flight.
races down the track but this was pushed through flat, Miller can only get it as far as long-on
length ball outside off and it's a one-bounce four. Maxi and Miller punch their gloves as they record a hundred stand. Carted away off the front foot and deep midwicket had no chance
he has flicked this from way outside off to deep square leg. The full toss helped him but the strength of his bottom hand is startling
offcutter on middle, Miller adjusts and pushes to long-off
goes for the yorker and it ends up a low full toss. Miller flays his bat at it and gets a boundary off the outside edge
that's about the only ball that seems to keep him quiet. Fires in a yorker which is dug out for a single
there was a man there at long-on. He flung himself up in search of the ball, but it beat him comfortably. length from the bowler and Maxi slammed it
driven down the ground to keep strike. Phew. What an over
and we're back to regularly scheduled programming. Length ball outside off, Maxi gets forward and slog sweeps it into the crowd at midwicket
flighted outside off, a little slower this time. Maxi nudges into the covers quite calmly
reverse swept and it sails over the boundary at deep third man. Maxi is making my fingers bleed here. Shot after shot after shot
through the fielder at deep midwicket! It was McCullum too. He's a pretty decent man to have on the boundary but Maxi had just hit it too hard!
this time it's the straight boundary! Tossed up on and around off stump and Maxi wound up and launched it into a desk full of security.

wild slog off a good length ball that kicked off the pitch. Dhoni can't get behind it and the ball runs away to the third man boundary. Such a good ball, but you won't realise it on the scorecard later on
fires it thorugh against Miller and he can't control the punch back at him. Pick up a singe as the ball wanders away towards midwicket
slower and nicely tossed up on middle, Maxi opens the face towards short third man for a quick single
this time makes a little room for himself to shovel the length ball, pushed flatter on middle, towards short third man
it's getting infectious here. Miller races down the track, gets to the pitch and once it's in the arc.... Long-on had no chance
tossed up just outside off, driven through extra
flighted on middle and off, Maxi drags it to deep midwicket
and now he's shot one way down the off side. Ashwin is completely rattled
he doesn't want to get in Maxi's range and ends up bowling it wide down leg
this legspinner becomes a full toss and Maxi stands and thumps it into the crowd behind square leg. That was massive
I was expecting a reverse sweep, but Maxi goes for the orthodox one and has sent it sailing over square leg.
a little slower through the air and Miller drives a little uppishly down the ground to long-off
no spin on offer for him as this goes on with the arm, Miller pushes to the left of the bower but Ashwin gets to it
good length ball on and around leg stump, Miller clips to deep midwicket
slower ball angled in at him, Maxi was almost deceived but went through the shot anyway and pushes down the ground
full and just outside off, Miller punches to long-off
stays back to the short delivery, lets it come on and then dab it behind point with soft hands
clears midwicket. That was pure power. Raina leaps as high as he could but the flat missile soars past his extended fingertips. Midwicket slog mightily executed
doesn't want to give Miller any room. Understandable considering how sweetly he's driven in this little innings. Goes for a flick and has to settle for a single in front of square leg
flighted outside off, driven through the covers
goes for the reverse scoop, but this was slower as well and doesn't have the pace he wanted. Lobbed up in the air but there was no short third man
that might have stayed a touch low. Jaddu gave this a little more air and the ball straightened a touch to beat his outside edge
leans forward and beats extra cover on his left to pick up a well-placed couple to the deep
good length ball, pushed flatter on middle. Pushed down to long-on
tossed up outside off, Miller drills it through extra cover. Smith was the man at long-off and he presents the old bridge through the legs to let the ball through
good length ball on middle and leg and it holds up a touch to make Miller's nudge travel in the air for a while before finding long-on
that time he errs in length and Miller has pulled it behind square leg. He's catching up on those dot balls now
keeps to a good length on off stump, Miller's nudge is taken care of by a diving midwicket
a little more bounce as he saw the batsman start advancing. Switches his length shorter and Miller's flash doesn't connect. He was a little cramped as well
walks down the pitch and nudges the back of a good length ball into the midwicket region
just short of a good length and Maxi shuffles across to try and pick it off his hips. Wears it on the thigh but these are two quick runners out there
good length ball just outside off, defended into the covers
a little too full and Miller's been timing the drive brilliantly so far. This time he finds the gap too. Hit straight down the ground
a little slower on off stump, Maxi plants his front leg down the pitch and flicks it through midwicket
fires in a yorker on off stump, but this time Maxi is able to dig it out.
good length ball outside off, Miller drives on the up through the covers. McCullum is the man there but the ball sneaks past his dive
full and outside off, Maxi drags it from outside off towards deep midwicket
walks down and drives the fuller ball outside off into the covers
he's obviously got confidence from that strike. Produces a fine bouncer on middle and off and Miller sways away from the line
good length ball on and around his off stump, pushed into the covers
gets one to curl back in but Miller negotiates it well. Presents a straight bat and drives the fuller ball to mid-on
Oh, he's dragged on! He dabbed at a good length delivery with an angled blade and Hilfy manages to nip it back enough to take the inside edge, hit the pads and cannon into the stumps
lured into pushing away from his body and he gets a thick outside edge to a back of a length delivery. Third man mops up
good length ball seeking middle of middle, but all he gets is the middle of Sehwag's bat
back of a length and outside off, Sehwag punches it towards point. And is also set to take advantage of an overthrow. When was the last time we saw that?
this seemed to bounce a little more off the pitch. Mohit has a knack for that and though Sehwag was surprised, he drew his bottom hand off the bat and placed the steer past the waiting man at gully.

walks down, makes room and carves this straight down third man's throat. That was not his job, all he needed to do was put Sehwag on strike but he couldn't help himself. Tried to manufacture a stroke but gets more of a thick outside edge
spears it at his pads and Sehwag can't connect with the flick this time. Has to settle for a leg bye behind square leg
short and wide, Sehwag goes for his patented cut but misses. Swings his bat in disappointment
back of a length and Sehwag rises up on his toes and punches through the covers
digs it in short but Sehwag doesn't bother with it. Good height on that
steers a back of a length ball through point to trot across to the non-strikers'
this time he gets cramped up on middle and leg. Hilfy appeals as the good length ball skids on to strike him on the pads
length and Sehwag has banished it over long-on! It was the change of pace from Hilfy, but Sehwag saw it early and exhibited a full, clean swing
goes fuller but Mandeep manages to chop it past the flying Jadeja. He's been on fire at point, this time hurling himself to his left and saving a single
targets off stump on a good length, Sehwag moves his weight across and tucks it to midwicket
this time he opens the face and steers a good length ball to deep third man
makes room as he steps down, Mohit follows him and the good length ball sneaks through bat and pad. Awful cross-bat swing.
looks to hack a good length ball from outside off through the leg side and gets an inside edge. Still not off the mark yet
Jaddu has to dive to his right this time. A little fuller but it still had enough width for the cut. Struck it very well, but that off side field is packed
shortish and outside off, Mandeep slaps it to point. Strong wrists again
hint of swing away from the bat, but this was a little too far for him to reach and strike properly. Gets a bottom edge which wanders back to the bowler. Twelve runs off the over
over cover this time. No need to bother about footwork when you can time it like that. Another full delivery with ample room for him to free his arms
fullish on off stump, Sehwag drills it to mid-off
carved over point! This is the Sehwag we've waited for. This was overpitched outside off and he threw his hands at it. Just a couple of bounces before hammering into the boundary boards
laced through midwicket, this time he's hit it hard enough to beat the fielder. A little too straight and that bottom hand is as strong as ever
good length ball on off stump, Sehwag keeps to his crease and punches to mid-off
pushed into the covers and he will retain strike
shortish and outside off, Sehwag caresses it behind point but Jadeja dives to his right to keep it under control
gets across to middle and off, Sehwag looks to force it down the ground. The ball might have held onto the pitch a little more as the ball lobs back towards the bowler
again, this one was short of a length and Sehwag misses a glance. Hilfy attempts an appeal to hoodwink the ump, but he already had his hands outstretched
bouncer, but it slides a little down leg. Hilfenhaus isn't too happy with the call, but it was a perfectly fair one
the angled bat comes down on a back of a length ball that thuds into the hands of cover
over compensation and Sehwag clips a fuller delivery off his toes through midwicket.
magnificent! Floats in a half-volley and though it swung away a touch, Sehwag eases into a drive through the covers. Minimum effort, maximum reward
short ball, hurries him as he goes for a pull. Sails over the fine leg boundary to end a thorough thumping. And that's saying something considering CSK made 187
he has to bowl that again. Slower ball slanted well down the off side
keeps it full on middle, tucked to deep midwicket
another outside edge and another four to third man. Backed away but the bowler tried to put it out of his reach outside off, but Ashwin is able to get just enough bat
gets a lucky outside edge that dribbles away. this was the legcutter and the deflection beats the dive of the keeper
fires it in full and on middle, they pick up a couple to deep midwicket
just short of a good length and Manhas lofts it down to long-off
walks across and drags this short ball to square leg
the top hand came off the bat as he goes for the pull. But this Johnson short ball was a little too quick for him. Top edge caught easily at midwicket
shortish and outside off, steered through point to the man in the deep
gets under this length ball and sent it soaring over the long-on boundary. Think he held the pace off on that and gets punished
full toss outside off, belted to midwicket
goes outside off to try and scoop it over the head of short fine leg, but the connection is too feeble. Kartik moves to his left and collects a simple catch
full and wide outside off, Faf drills it to long-off
wide yorker, Dhoni stays rooted to his crease as he looks to chop at the ball. Gets an inside edge for a single
advances down again, but this time he can only down to long-on

this is the slower ball, a response to seeing the batsman moving around in his crease. But as the ball was bowled he was waiting on leg stump and tickled it fine again to bring up his fifty, off 22 balls
makes room as he chips down the track and lashes it through the covers
Faf jumped outside leg, Sandeep went further down and played into his hands. Glanced to the fine leg boundary
yorker just outside off, Faf picks up a single to point to make it 17 off the over
down the track and hammers it over extra cover. That's another magnificent strike. Again it was in the slot and he turned it into an overpitched delivery too
slower bouncer and Faf checks his pull. Still goes where he did not intend it to as the glove gives the ball enough impetus to beat the leaping keeper
there's the elusive short ball at over 145kph. Dhoni is caught hopping at the crease and picks up a single of the glove
walks across and looks to slash the slower delivery outside off, gets an inside edge to the left of the keeper
launched back over his head! Terrific strike, but one feels it's a little too late. It was length and he swung the bat through the line of the ball.
skips down the track and works it to deep midwicket for a couple
another nudge to midwicket, another couple.
backs away and slogs the flat, length ball down to long-on
stays back and pushes to extra cover for a single
goes for it, but this was slid a little too quickly on his pads to connect with the bat
tapped calmly into midwicket where deep square leg beats Maxwell to the ball
worked away through midwicket and there's two for the taking. This is a very big ground
good work from Bailey at extra cover. Faf came down the track and thumps it through the off side, but the fielder ran across to his left and planted enough doubts
dabbed between backward point and short third man
chopped back to the bowler as he doesn't afford him any room
pulled to deep square leg as Akshar fires it flat on off stump
ran down the track and turned it away to short fine leg
saw the batsman stepping down and bowled it flat, only Faf was making room outside leg and had enough room to free his arms and drill it past the dive of the sweeper. Consecutive fours for CSK
there's a little more intent. Faf dances down and pummels it down the ground. Kartick dived to try and stop it but it was struck far too hard for him
comes down the track and nurdles it straight of deep midwicket and this time it's a well run two to Johnson
no flight offered to Dhoni, who goes deep in his crease and pushes through extra cover
this time he waits on it but still can't beat backward point
chopped into the covers as he backs away against a flat, length ball
hustles through for a quick single after nudging to extra cover
flighted delivery, driven to long-off
moves way outside leg and the bowler follows him. Takes it off leg stump but can only tap it to extra cover
chips down the track and picks up a single to Maxwell who is prowling at the midwicket boundary
goes back and punches the flatter, length ball to Maxi at deep midwicket
flat on middle and leg, Dhoni clips off his legs through midwicket

skips down the track for a couple to deep midwicket, but wait this is a direct hit! Mitchell Johnson collected the ball with one hand and hurled it on target at the bowlers'. McCullum was carrying his helmet while he was rushing between the wickets and is caught short by a few inches. What a throw, swift, flat and dead on.
goes deep in his crease and works it through the midwicket region and since both men are back, it's an easy couple
backs away and shovels it through to deep cover
flatter and outside off, Faf flicks it deep mdiwicket
pulls this off middle but straight to deep midwicket. Looks like McCullum's going to go for it now
clears his front leg and slashes the length ball to deep point and again some fine running gets a couple
fullish and outside off, Faf tickles it to deep square leg and called for two straight away. Excellent running

was that bowled? The good length ball stayed a little low and skidded through Jaddu's hurried prod. They're going to the third ump to see if the bails were disturbed by the ball and not the keeper's gloves. And we have confirmation of that. Except, Dhawan's front foot almost seemed to have toed the line. It certainly slipped over, but when he landed it he was fine. Well, it doesn't matter now. Jaddu has to walk back
goes for the slog sweep, but it strikes him on the ribs. A little bit of a leg cutting knuckle ball and it beats him for lack of pace. Might have been too high for the leg before appeal
comes down the track and punches the back of a length delivery to mid-off
cut away and he's struck it well, but the sweeper races to his left and keeps it to a single
pushes it on a good length just outside off, McCullum goes for a cut but inside edges it

a little room outside off and Jaddu has cut it fine of the sweeper. Collects a couple. He's looked in prime touch so far. Guess Dhoni really knows his stuff. Plus remember, Punjab have two left-arm spinners
pushed down leg and Jaddu uses the extra pace of the one that was pushed through. Glanced fine to the boundary behind him
looped up into the block hole, McCullum pushes to long-on
a little turn again as he gets the tossed up delivery to straighten outside off. Raina dabs towards short third man for a quick single
short and wide and he's cut it brilliantly between short third man and backward point. How bout that for timing
flighted on leg stump, Baz keeps his legs out of the way and pushes down the ground
fired in on middle and leg, McCullum pushes down the ground. it was hit hard but the bowler gets a hand to it to keep it to a single
this one skidded on with the arm and McCullum was hurried into protecting his stumps. Well bowled
carved through extra, that's a McCullum special! Raced down the track and though the ball was flat, he made enough room to give it a good whack
pulls his length back a touch and Jaddu turns it away to long-on
that was in the slot, Jaddu loaded up and slams it down the ground. Long-off can only usher it to the boundary
shuffles across to off stump and nudges through midwicket. Is McCullum CSK's anchor today?
loopy delivery well outside off, McCullum lashes it through extra cover
tossed up outside leg, McCullum opts for the sweep and beats Sehwag at short fine leg. He's not going to chase after that. Actually signals the ball boy
pushed through on the pads, McCullum looks to nudge, but doesn't connect

Maxi and Miller, they combine well even with the ball in hand! Raina dances down the track to heave a flighted ball over extra cover. But he doesn't get enough timing on it. Long off runs up and dives forward to complete the catch.
pushed back towards the bowler, Maxi tries a flick off the back of his hand to try and run Raina out and he would have been had that hit the target
stays around the wicket to the right-hander too, but this is fired in way too wide outside off
pushed in on the pads, Raina is down the track but can only push it to long-on
this stayed low as Akshar fires it in. Raina works it away through midwicket to retain strike
comes down the track and steers the flat, length ball through the covers
cuts from around off stump, but sweeper keeps it to a single
pushes it through at the base of middle, Raina looks to flick across the line and is lucky for that ball deflecting away from the stumps
not too much spin out there as he targets off stump, Baz backs away to cut but doesn't connect too well
skips down the track, but he doesn't reach the pitch and bunts it down to long-on
grants him width and Raina smacks it over the covers. But there is protection in the deep
slower ball, just back of a length, Baz taps towards point for a single

chips down the track but his launch over the top came off the bottom of the bat. Gained way more height than he liked and Mitch was chasing after it. Lunged after it with both hands but he never looked in control. Swirler that was, no one would blame Johnson for not grabbing that
tempts him outside off with a back of a length ball, Raina slashes and picks up a single to the sweeper
how bout that! Raina stayed put on the crease and swiped a length ball over the boundary at wide long-on. Picked up and dispatched. Terrific strike
slower ball on off stump, Baz uses soft hands towards point
panicked as he saw Raina making room and looped up a full toss. Calmly punched through the covers
pushed through on the pads, Raina works to midwicket
thumped straight down the ground. It was bowled flatter but Raina's footwork pipped him. And a straight bat helps his cause
goes down the track but the length is pulled back and pushed on his pads, nudges for a single through midwicket
makes a little room and lashes this over the top and finds a boundary to extra cover. Calculated shot from McCullum as he beats long-off who was running to his left
tossed up on middle and off, he comes forward and blocks with an open face
one-bounce four over point. Backed away to try and gain some room and he carved this short ball clean over point
bit of width but Raina has slapped this straight to point. Still nervous about moving his feet and I don't blame him, Mitch is bowing some serious pace
gets a bottom edge which doesn't go too far. It was shortish and outside off, he looked to run it off the face, but doesn't get it past gully
shortish and outside off, McCullum taps it to deep third man
straight down the ground, but he hasn't got it quite off the middle. Full on off stump, he strides forward and punches down the ground. Akshar Patel raced from mid-off to pull it back
keeps it fullish and outside off, Raina slices it behind point. Where's the bouncer?
fullish and straightening on off stump, Baz couldn't do much else than a defensive
chipped up in the but midwicket is on the fence. Wanted to tuck him up on the pads and Raina doesn't quite time the flick
short of a good length around the off stump, Raina dabs it to gully

Mandeep, you beauty! This was struck very hard by Raina. Took it on the up and punched it through the covers. It looked set for the boundary until the fielder hurls himself at the ball and kept it to two
pokes his bat outside off and gets a couple to the sweeper. Another away swinger on a good length outside off
had to reach out as the length ball drifts away off the bat. Point keeps it down to nothing
walks across to off stump and pulls the shortish ball down to long leg. Made a little tonk as bat made contact off the bottom of the bat
shortish but it only rises up to Raina's hips, nudged behind square leg for a couple. Not exactly comfortably though.
steered to gully as this is shortish and just a shade outside off. They're cutting out a rich scoring area for Raina
went a little wide of the crease and gets a back of a length delivery to straighten. Raina blocks down the wrong line and is well beaten.
jumps back in his crease as he blocks a 145kph thunderbolt back at the bowler
goes for a just short of a length and outside off, dabs towards backward point
another beautiful delivery! It's on a length, pitches outside off, keeps curving away. Baz leaves it alone
they get the big fish early! Smith looks to hoick the back of length delivery over point, but gets a thick edge that lobs up for Mitchell Johnson at backward point
closer to the offstump line and still has that shape. Smith defends it to midwicket off the back foot
superb delivery! It's short of length and curves away from the batsman after pitching to beat the outside edge
no, they are not going to wait! Another outswinger, but this is full enough for Smith to get under.. he just chips it over extra cover for a one-bounce four
lovely outswinger that beats the outside edge! Smith was poking his bat at that one but didn't account for that shape
